root_causes.title: Missing Infigraph runtime wrapper and capability discovery
root_causes.description: The knowledgebase lacks integration with the Infigraph CLI, requiring a new wrapper for reproducible execution and capability discovery.
root_causes.solution_summary: Create a new module `scripts/kb/infigraph.py` with pinned metadata and a `check_capabilities` function that robustly handles execution, timeouts, and malformed outputs.

tasks.title: Add reproducible Infigraph runtime wrapper
